story.text: 승객님, 이제 곧 이륙합니다. 벨트 확인 좀 도와드릴까요? 아, 이건 진짜 업무예요.
story.reading: seung-gaek-nim, i-je got i-ryuk-ham-ni-da. bel-teu hwa-gin jom do-wa-deu-ril-kka-yo? a, i-geon jin-jja eop-mu-ye-yo.
story.en: We're about to take off. Shall I help you check your belt? Ah, this part is actually my real job.

story.text: '안전벨트'는 제가 매드릴까요, 아니면... 마음까지 매드릴까요? 아 이런 멘트 때문에 바람둥이 소리 듣나 봐요, 하하.
story.reading: an-jeon-bel-teu-neun je-ga mae-deu-ril-kka-yo, a-ni-myeon... ma-eum-kka-ji mae-deu-ril-kka-yo? a i-reon men-teu ttae-mun-e ba-ram-dung-i so-ri deun-na bwa-yo, ha-ha.
story.en: Shall I fasten your 'seatbelt' for you, or... shall I fasten your heart too? Ha, lines like that are probably why people call me a player.

story.text: 지금 창밖으로 '한강'이 보이네요. 저 강물보다 승객님 눈이 더 반짝이는데요. 이런 말, 아무한테나 막 하는 거 아니에요.
story.reading: ji-geum chang-bak-eu-ro han-gang-i bo-i-ne-yo. jeo gang-mul-bo-da seung-gaek-nim nun-i deo ban-jjak-i-neun-de-yo. i-reon mal, a-mu-han-te-na mak ha-neun geo a-ni-e-yo.
story.en: You can see the 'Han River' out the window right now. But your eyes sparkle more than that river. I don't just say this to anyone, you know.

story.text: '창밖' 풍경 보라고 안내해 드렸는데, 자꾸 이쪽만 보고 계시네요. ...저도 마찬가지지만요.
story.reading: chang-bak pung-gyeong bo-ra-go an-nae-hae deu-ryeot-neun-de, ja-kku i-jjok-man bo-go gye-si-ne-yo. ...jeo-do ma-chan-ga-ji-ji-man-yo.
story.en: I told you to look at the view 'outside the window', but you keep looking this way instead. ...though I'm doing the same.

story.text: 이 '기내'에 승객님 웃음소리만 울리면 좋겠는데, 그건 기장 욕심이겠죠? 소문처럼 여기저기 다 그러는 거 아니고요.
story.reading: i gi-nae-e seung-gaek-nim us-eum-so-ri-man ul-li-myeon jo-ket-neun-de, geu-geon gi-jang yok-sim-i-get-jyo? so-mun-cheo-reom yeo-gi-jeo-gi da geu-reo-neun geo a-ni-go-yo.
story.en: I wish the only sound in this 'cabin' were your laughter — but that's probably just a captain's wishful thinking, right? And no, I'm not like that with everyone, whatever the rumors say.

story.text: 농담이 아니라, 요즘 제 '마음'이 자꾸 이쪽 좌석으로 기울어요.
story.reading: nong-dam-i a-ni-ra, yo-jeum je ma-eum-i ja-kku i-jjok jwa-seok-eu-ro gi-ul-eo-yo.
story.en: I'm not joking — lately my 'heart' keeps leaning toward this seat.

story.text: 자, 순항고도에 다 왔네요. 이제 오늘 배운 단어들, 문제로 한번 점검해볼까요?
story.reading: ja, sun-hang-go-do-e da wan-ne-yo. i-je o-neul bae-un dan-eo-deul, mun-je-ro han-beon jeom-geom-hae-bol-kka-yo?
story.en: Alright, we've reached cruising altitude. Shall we check today's words with a quick quiz now?

words.example_en: Please be sure to fasten your seatbelt.
The plane passes over the Han River.
The view outside the window is truly beautiful.
Please rest comfortably in the cabin.
My heart keeps leaning toward you.
